items.title: Feedbacks between natural climate solutions and plant invasions
items.title_en: Feedbacks between natural climate solutions and plant invasions
items.title_zh: 自然气候解决方案与植物入侵之间的反馈作用
items.summary_en: Biological invasions and carbon sequestration guide many modern-day land management decisions. However, intersections between invasions and natural climate solutions (NCS)—actions to maintain or increase the land carbon sink—have not received adequate attention in either the invasion or climate mitigation literature. We therefore review how plant invasions affect NCS and vice versa, focusing on reductions in emissions and carbon removals associated with avoided habitat conversion, restoration, forest and cropland management, agroforestry, and optimal grazing. We find that plant invasions can interfere with rapid NCS implementation and reduce the durability of carbon storage in many systems, although there are cases in which invasive plants increase carbon storage, creating biodiversity-climate mitigation trade-offs. At the same time, studies find that several NCS increase community resistance/resilience to invasions, and do so in forests, in particular, which can suppress invasive species spread in these systems. These dynamics suggest a positive feedback loop between NCS and invasions, in which NCS facilitate invasion control, and successful invasion control, in turn, eases further NCS implementation. This feedback could accelerate gains in land-based carbon storage and generate co-benefits for biodiversity, provided that NCS projects receive resources for sustained invasive species management. We highlight areas in need of further research, including how financial mechanisms for climate action could be used to overcome invasion-induced implementation barriers.
items.summary_zh: 生物入侵和碳封存是当今许多土地管理决策的重要依据。然而，入侵与自然气候解决方案（NCS）——即旨在维持或增加土地碳汇的举措——之间的交集，无论是在入侵研究文献还是气候减缓文献中，都尚未得到充分关注。 因此，我们回顾了植物入侵如何影响自然气候解决方案，反之亦然，重点探讨了通过避免栖息地转化、生态修复、森林和农田管理、农林复合经营以及优化放牧所带来的减排和碳移除效应。 我们发现，尽管在某些情况下入侵植物会增加碳储量，从而产生生物多样性与气候减缓之间的权衡，但植物入侵可能会干扰自然气候解决方案的快速实施，并降低许多系统中碳储存的持久性。 与此同时，研究发现，若干自然碳储量措施可增强群落对入侵的抵抗力/韧性，特别是在森林中，从而抑制入侵物种在这些系统中的扩散。 这些动态表明，NCS 与入侵物种之间存在正反馈循环：NCS 有助于控制入侵，而成功的入侵控制反过来又促进了 NCS 的进一步实施。只要 NCS 项目获得用于持续管理入侵物种的资源，这种反馈就能加速陆地碳储量的增长，并为生物多样性带来协同效益。 我们重点指出了需要进一步研究的领域，包括如何利用气候行动的金融机制来克服入侵物种引发的实施障碍。

items.title: Scientists confirm global warming is accelerating faster than ever recorded
items.title_en: Scientists confirm global warming is accelerating faster than ever recorded
items.title_zh: 科学家证实，全球变暖的速度正以有史以来最快的速度加快
items.summary_en: Earth is warming faster than ever recorded, with scientists detecting a major acceleration in global temperatures since around 2015. A new study reveals that the warming rate has surged to approximately 0.35°C per decade, nearly double the average pace observed from 1970 to 2015. After removing natural climate fluctuations, researchers confirmed the acceleration with more than 98% statistical confidence.
items.summary_zh: 地球变暖的速度已达到有记录以来的最快水平，科学家们发现，自2015年左右以来，全球气温上升速度显著加快。 一项新研究显示，变暖速率已飙升至每十年约0.35°C，几乎是1970年至2015年期间观测到的平均速度的两倍。在剔除自然气候波动因素后，研究人员以超过98%的统计置信度证实了这一加速趋势。

items.title: National-scale PM2.5 health consequences of a proposed LNG power project in South Korea: looking beyond localized assessment boundaries
items.title_en: National-scale PM2.5 health consequences of a proposed LNG power project in South Korea: looking beyond localized assessment boundaries
items.title_zh: 韩国某拟建液化天然气发电项目对全国范围PM2.5健康影响的研究：超越局部评估范围
items.summary_en: Environmental impact assessments (EIAs) in South Korea rely heavily on localized dispersion models within restricted geographical boundaries (∼10 km), failing to capture regional secondary PM2.5 formation and broad population exposure. To address these limitations, this study pursues two distinct objectives: (1) evaluating systemic deficiencies in the current EIA framework, and (2) quantifying the nationwide health impacts and monetized mortality damages of a proposed 3 GW liquefied natural gas power cluster at the Yongin Semiconductor Industrial Complex. We employed Global InMAP—selected specifically for its ability to simulate long-range atmospheric transport and secondary PM2.5 chemistry across national scales where local models fail—under 35%, 55%, and 75% capacity factor (CF) scenarios. Health outcomes were modeled nationwide and monetized using domestic and international Values of a Statistical Life. Regarding health impact quantification, the proposed cluster is projected to cause 21.5–31.1 additional annual premature deaths nationwide, with secondary PM2.5 driving 63%–71% of this burden. Under the central 55% CF scenario, annual monetized mortality damages range from 34.4 billion KRW (∼USD 23 million; domestic benchmark) to 195.9–295.5 billion KRW (∼USD 143–201 million; international benchmarks). Regarding EIA framework evaluation, spatial disaggregation revealed critical regulatory blind spots: only 14%–16% of attributable premature deaths occur within the typical 10 km EIA assessment radius, while 67%–69% fall outside Yongin City and 46%–47% outside host Gyeonggi Province. Geographically bounded EIAs omit the vast majority of health externalities; regulatory frameworks must integrate regional secondary PM2.5 modeling and transparently monetize health damages in energy planning decisions.
items.summary_zh: 韩国的环境影响评估（EIA）主要依赖于限定地理范围（约10公里）内的局部扩散模型，未能全面反映区域性PM2.5的二次生成及广泛人群的暴露情况。 为解决这些局限性，本研究旨在实现两个明确目标：（1）评估当前EIA框架中的系统性缺陷；（2）量化拟建于龙仁半导体工业园区的3吉瓦液化天然气发电集群对全国范围内的健康影响及可量化的死亡损害。 我们采用了Global InMAP模型——该模型因其能够模拟跨国家尺度的长距离大气传输和二次PM2.5化学反应（而局部模型在此方面存在局限）而被专门选中——并在35%、55%和75%的容量因子（CF）情景下进行了模拟。 健康影响在全国范围内进行了建模，并采用国内和国际的“统计生命价值”标准进行了货币化评估。就健康影响量化而言，预计该拟建集群将在全国范围内每年导致21.5–31.1例额外过早死亡，其中二次PM2.5导致了63%–71%的死亡负担。 在55%容量因子的中心情景下，年度货币化死亡损害范围为344亿韩元（约合2300万美元；国内基准）至1959亿–2955亿韩元（约合1.43–2.01亿美元；国际基准）。 关于环境影响评估（EIA）框架的评估，空间分解揭示了关键的监管盲点：仅有14%–16%的可归因过早死亡发生在典型的10公里EIA评估半径范围内，而67%–69%发生在龙仁市以外，46%–47%发生在项目所在地京畿道以外。 受地理边界限制的环境影响评估忽略了绝大多数健康外部性；监管框架必须整合区域性PM2.5二次沉降模型，并在能源规划决策中以透明的方式对健康损害进行货币化评估。

items.summary_en: Scientists may have solved a 66-million-year-old mystery: how crocodiles survived the asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs. A sweeping analysis of fossils and ancient climates suggests that their preference for warm environments placed them in tropical refuges that remained habitable even after the catastrophic impact.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们可能解开了6600万年前的一个谜团：鳄鱼是如何在小行星撞击导致恐龙灭绝后幸存下来的。对化石和古气候的全面分析表明，由于鳄鱼偏好温暖的环境，它们栖息在热带避难所中，这些地区即使在灾难性撞击发生后，仍然适宜生存。
